company_context: Berlin B2B SaaS startup (founded 2023, bootstrapped) building GTM intelligence and LinkedIn content tools for small B2B firms in DACH, the UK and the Czech Republic.
title: Software engineering intern (GTM platform and LLM integration)
summary: Specified, rebuilt and extended a GTM platform serving six B2B clients in Germany, the UK and the Czech Republic.

highlights.text: Rebuilt the LinkedIn content service, then built a shared core library, the identity portal and the GTM engine.
Built the shared LLM router: 6 model routes across 4 providers, switching at 95% of a provider's daily free quota.
Built enrichment on Apify and Tavily in ARQ background workers on Redis, feeding LLM-based ICP scoring.
Documented 46 functional and 11 non-functional requirements, 15 user stories and a traceability matrix.

title: AI engineer intern
summary: Prototyped a voice interview pipeline for InterQ, an AI interview platform, integrating VAPI with Gemini 2.5 Flash, and defined its API contracts.

title: Full-stack developer (volunteer)
summary: Replaced manual scheduling and attendance tracking with a web workflow for training requests, availability checks, attendance and CSV exports.

highlights.text: Saved staff about 3 hours of admin work per week.

title: Web developer intern
summary: Documented requirements and REST API contracts for MyVioo, a white-label video-on-demand platform, and wrote its functional test cases.
